purpose: Tracks shared credential variables used by Khashi VC, Investing System, and Nous Hermes control-plane readiness. Values are never stored here.

variables.name: BINANCE_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Binance.US market data identity for crypto/perpetual technical context.

variables.name: BINANCE_SECRET_KEY
variables.purpose: Binance.US signed credential partner for market data/account-capability checks where used.

variables.name: PUBLIC_COM_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Public.com broker/account and equity-market context.

variables.name: PUBLIC_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Legacy Public.com key alias.

variables.name: FINNHUB_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Fundamental, macro, forex/metals provider data where covered.

variables.name: MASSIVE_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Historical stock/options bars, option contracts, option trades, and earnings-options research archives.

variables.name: MASSIVE_API_BASE_URL
variables.purpose: Massive API base URL override.

variables.name: FRED_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Rates, liquidity, inflation, macro, and market-regime context.

variables.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Daily metals fallback and web-derived macro context.

variables.name: FIRECRAWL_BASE_URL
variables.purpose: Firecrawl API base URL override.

variables.name: KHASHI_VC_API_BASE_URL
variables.purpose: Khashi VC service API base URL for cross-project trading intelligence and event-contract context.

variables.name: KALSHI_BASE_URL

variables.name: KALSHI_API_KEY_ID

variables.name: KALSHI_API_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH

variables.name: ROBINHOOD_MCP_URL
variables.purpose: Robinhood MCP endpoint for read-only/event-contract discovery.

variables.name: ROBINHOOD_MCP_CLI
variables.purpose: Robinhood MCP CLI path when the local transport is used.

variables.name: SEC_USER_AGENT
variables.purpose: SEC EDGAR-compliant user agent for filings/company-facts ingestion.

variables.name: NASDAQ_DATA_LINK_API_KEY

variables.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN

variables.name: DISCORD_TRADING_CHANNEL_ID

variables.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN

variables.name: TELEGRAM_ALERT_CHAT_IDS
variables.purpose: Telegram destination chats for alerts.

rules: Credential health endpoints may report configured/missing/source key names only.
Credential health endpoints must never return raw values, prefixes, hashes, or lengths.
Configured credentials do not unlock live trading by themselves.
Live/paper promotion gates must consume readiness as evidence, not permission.
